title: Smart Data Models - CityJSON v2.0 - BuildingUnit
description: https://www.cityjson.org/schemas/2.0.2/cityobjects.schema.json#BuildingUnit. A functional/ownership unit of a Building, e.g. an apartment or office suite, which may span multiple BuildingRooms. Part of the Building family of City Objects. Typed attributes cross-referenced from the CityGML 3.0 Building module (schemas.opengis.net/citygml/), the data model CityJSON's own attributes are informally derived from.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BuildingUnit'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

class.description: Property. Indicates the specific type of the building subdivision. Coded value, typically drawn from an OGC CityGML code list (not resolved to a closed enum in this pass).

function.description: Property. Specifies the intended purposes of the building subdivision. Coded value, typically drawn from an OGC CityGML code list (not resolved to a closed enum in this pass).

usage.description: Property. Specifies the actual uses of the building subdivision. Coded value, typically drawn from an OGC CityGML code list (not resolved to a closed enum in this pass).

sortKey.description: Property. Defines an order among the objects that belong to the building subdivision. An example is the sorting of storeys.

genericAttributes.description: Property. Open StructuredValue for additional name/value attributes beyond the typed properties above, per CityGML 3.0's own formal generic-attribute extension mechanism (generics.xsd: CodeAttribute, StringAttribute, DoubleAttribute, IntAttribute, DateAttribute, UriAttribute, MeasureAttribute, GenericAttributeSet). Not schema-validated by this candidate; use the typed properties above where one exists.

geographicalExtent.description: Property. Bounding box of the City Object as [minx, miny, minz, maxx, maxy, maxz], per the source CityJSON schema's shared _AbstractCityObject.geographicalExtent.

parents.description: Relationship. IDs of the parent City Object(s) in the same dataset, per the source CityJSON schema's shared _AbstractCityObject.parents.

children.description: Relationship. IDs of the child City Object(s) in the same dataset, per the source CityJSON schema's shared _AbstractCityObject.children.

location.description: GeoProperty. Dereferenced GeoJSON MultiPoint for this address entry, flattened from the source schema's address[].location (a CityJSON MultiPoint of vertex indices).

items.description: Per the source schema, an address entry may carry additional fields beyond `location` (e.g. street/house-number conventions inherited from CityGML xAL addressing) that are not fixed by this JSON Schema; only `location` is structurally declared.

address.description: Property/Relationship mix. One or more addresses associated with this BuildingUnit, per the source schema's address property (present only on Building, BuildingUnit, Bridge, BridgePart).

geometryLoD0.description: GeoProperty. Dereferenced GeoJSON geometry (MultiPolygon) for this BuildingUnit at major Level of Detail 0 (covers source `lod` values "0" and "0.0"-"0.3"), flattened from CityJSON's native shared-vertex-array + boundary-index representation. Optional; present only if the source CityJSON file provides a Geometry entry at this LoD for this object. Surface `semantics`, `material`, and `texture` are not carried into this GeoProperty -- only boundary coordinates.
